settings.content: The palette is fixed in theme.css from the official HANAN colour sheet. These settings cover the images and links that change without a code edit.

Colourway swatches read the product metafields custom.swatch_hex and custom.style_group. Create both under Settings → Custom data → Products before importing, or the swatch row falls back to showing nothing.

settings.label: Show the drawn abaya silhouette where a product has no photograph
settings.info: Turn this off once every colourway has real photography.
